title: [finding] record:activity's `filterMode` sanitiser folds every unrecognised value onto `all` — the widest option, silently
body:
Found while implementing #5841 (the `types` sanitiser); filed unassigned, not fixed there — out of that card's fence.

#5841 ruled that `record:activity`'s `types` sanitiser must never silently WIDEN an author's request: an unrecognised or empty kind list now filters to nothing plus a diagnostic, rather than falling back to "every kind". The card's own body flagged that the same question applies to the sibling sanitiser in the same file, and it does.

## Measured at the live source

`packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/recordActivityFeed.ts`:

```ts
export function normalizeFilterMode(value: unknown): FeedFilterMode {
  return typeof value === 'string' && FILTER_MODE_VALUES.includes(value)
    ? (value as FeedFilterMode)
    : 'all';
}
```

`FeedFilterMode.options` is `['all', 'comments_only', 'changes_only', 'tasks_only']`, so `'all'` is the WIDEST option, and every unrecognised value folds onto it — including a near-miss like `comments-only` or `commentsOnly`. Nothing is logged. An author who mistypes the slice their page should open on gets the unfiltered stream and no signal.

## Why this is a question rather than an obvious bug

Unlike `types`, `filterMode` is not a final filter — it seeds a dropdown the user can change, and the existing rationale in the source is real:

> Unknown values fall back to `'all'` rather than being passed through: a `<Select>` handed a value with no matching item renders blank and the dropdown reads as broken. Same posture as objectui#3151.

So "refuse it" cannot mean "pass the bad value through" here — that produces a visibly broken control. The genuine options are narrower than they were for `types`:

- **A. Keep the fallback, add a diagnostic.** One deduped `console.warn` naming the unrecognised value and the declared options, reusing the `warnOnce` plumbing #5841 factored out in this file. Cheapest, and it removes the *invisibility* half without touching rendering. Nothing that renders today changes.
- **B. Fall back to a NARROWER default.** Rejected on its face for the record: there is no defensible narrower default, and picking one would invent an intent the author did not express.
- **C. Treat it as an author-time concern only.** Consistent with `filterMode` being user-changeable, but it leaves the same silent-widening shape the platform just ruled against on the neighbouring prop.

A is the recommendation. It is worth a triage ruling rather than a silent fix, because the never-widen principle was ruled for a *filter* and `filterMode` is a *control's initial state* — whether the principle reaches it is a judgement, not a mechanical follow-through.

## Landing

Same file and same package as #5841: `packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/recordActivityFeed.ts`, `@object-ui/plugin-detail`. The `warnOnce` seam and the per-channel dedupe bucket that A needs already exist there.
